assertions_evaluated.evidence: "Run agy-migrate with no flags. This produces a report of what it would do without changing anything."

assertions_evaluated.text: Explains skills are read in place via a skills.json entry, not copied
assertions_evaluated.evidence: "User skills | Live, not copied — skills.json gets an entry pointing at ~/.claude/skills"
